note.question: How do spence–mirrlees reservation prices affect cardinality bundling?
note.overview: This paper studies the pricing of cardinality bundles, where firms set prices that depend only on the size of the purchased bundle, a practice that is increasingly being adopted by industry. We correct prior approaches and develop various structural and managerial insights. The paper develops a fast combinatorial technique to obtain the optimal prices.
